posts.title: Ziggy Zapper and the Robot Factory
posts.description: It's been ages since I did a Ludum Dare, but I joined for their 59th event at the weekend. The theme was "Signal" and I made this puzzle game where you go round a robot factory with a remote control. I think it turned out okay!

posts.title: I learned something about GPUs today
posts.description: This is a writeup of a bugfix I did in Blackshift recently. I tried to write it like a murder mystery, showing you the bug first and then dropping clues until the reveal, so maybe if you're into graphics programming you'll go “aha!’ at some point and figure it out before you get to the end.

posts.title: Notfoundland
posts.description: Alakajam recently hosted a game jam to make something for their 404 page, and I ended up making a little explorey puzzle game.
